name: cTSSlotDescriptor::Read
notes: Hooked; coordinator owns in-game smoke testing. Differential: 2816 cases (128 each at versions 0..10, 0x3f..0x43, 0x46..0x48, 0x12345678, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff). Every getter failure position, multiple failures writing nothing, four error bytes (0/1/0x80/0xff), random initial object bytes, float edges, exact normalized call traces and guarded full-object comparison. All five Read mutants killed: float boundary 0x43->0x42; signed word->unsigned; +0x4c scaling extended to version 70; reused integer initialized to zero instead of stream pointer; old flag priority reversed. Failed integer getters consume a reused stream-argument stack slot (ORIGINAL-BUG), reproduced without excluding any object bytes. Below version 9, flag 0x200 takes priority over 0x400 and only the selected bit is cleared. +0x4c is scaled only below version 10; absent fields mostly retain their initial bytes.

name: cTSSlotDescriptor::Write
notes: Hooked; coordinator owns in-game smoke testing.
